title: The Golden Calf

questions.question: What did the people ask Aaron to make when Moses delayed on the mountain?
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:1 (ESV): "Up, make us gods who shall go before us."

questions.question: What idol did Aaron make?
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:4 (ESV): "He received the gold from their hand and fashioned it with a graving tool and made a golden calf."

questions.question: What did Moses do with the tablets when he saw the calf?
options: Threw them down and broke them
questions.correctAnswer: Threw them down and broke them
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:19 (ESV): "He threw the tablets out of his hands and broke them at the foot of the mountain."

questions.question: What did Moses do with the golden calf?
options: Burned it, ground it to powder, scattered it on water, and made them drink it
questions.correctAnswer: Burned it, ground it to powder, scattered it on water, and made them drink it
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:20 (ESV): "He took the calf that they had made and burned it with fire and ground it to powder and scattered it on the water and made the people of Israel drink it."

questions.question: What did Aaron collect from the people to make the idol?
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:2-3 (ESV): "Take off the rings of gold that are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters."

questions.question: Which tribe rallied to Moses' side?
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:26 (ESV): "All the sons of Levi gathered around him."

questions.question: What excuse did Aaron give Moses for the calf?
options: He threw gold into the fire and out came this calf
questions.correctAnswer: He threw gold into the fire and out came this calf
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:24 (ESV): "So I said to them, 'Let any who have gold take it off.' So they gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf."

questions.question: What did Moses say to God in interceding for the people?
options: Turn from your burning anger and relent from this disaster
Let me lead a new people
questions.correctAnswer: Turn from your burning anger and relent from this disaster
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:12 (ESV): "Turn from your burning anger and relent from this disaster against your people."

questions.question: What did God threaten to do to the people?
options: Consume them and make Moses into a great nation
questions.correctAnswer: Consume them and make Moses into a great nation
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:10 (ESV): "Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them and I may consume them, in order that I may make a great nation of you."

questions.question: How many fell that day when the Levites carried out judgment?
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:28 (ESV): "And that day about three thousand men of the people fell."

questions.question: What did Moses offer to God to atone for the people's sin?
options: To be blotted out of God's book himself
questions.correctAnswer: To be blotted out of God's book himself
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:32 (ESV): "But now, if you will forgive their sin—but if not, please blot me out of your book that you have written."

questions.question: What ancestors did Moses remind God of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:13 (ESV): "Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self."

questions.question: What did Joshua think the noise from the camp was?
options: The noise of war in the camp
questions.correctAnswer: The noise of war in the camp
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:17 (ESV): "Joshua said to Moses, 'There is a noise of war in the camp.'"

questions.question: What did God say about who He would blot out?
options: Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot out of my book
questions.correctAnswer: Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot out of my book
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:33 (ESV): "Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot out of my book."

questions.question: Did God relent from the disaster He had spoken of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 32:14 (ESV): "And the Lord relented from the disaster that he had spoken of bringing on his people."

key_verse_text: And the Lord relented from the disaster that he had spoken of bringing on his people.
